title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
author: Stephen Chbosky
current_text: In 2025 Utah banned The Perks of Being a Wallflower by Stephen Chbosky from all public schools in the state. In April 2025 the Lukashenko regime added the book to its list of printed publications that could harm the national interests of Belarus.
